name: review-feature
description: Use to run an independent, clean-context code review of an implemented feature against its PRD and acceptance criteria before shipping. Triggers on "review {slug}", "code review the changes for {slug}", "review the diff for {slug}", "is {slug} ready to ship", "/sdlc:review-feature {slug}", "переглянь зміни {slug}", "код-рев'ю фічі {slug}", "рев'ю diff". Dispatches the sdlc:reviewer subagent over the whole feature diff (stage 1 PRD/AC compliance end-to-end, stage 2 quality), collects cited findings, and resolves each with you. Hard-refuses if the feature is not implemented yet. Triggers: /sdlc:review-feature {slug}. Output: docs/features/{slug}/_review/review-<date>.md.
